name: Chrysalia
_turns: How many turns a game lasts (the arena doc); the turn track at the table's end has a slot for each.
_grid: One character per tile, row 0 = the far side (player 2), last row = player 1's side. Each character is defined in the legend. From the user's chalk drawing (mapstomake/chrysilia.webp, straightened from the photo): a mulch bed with water, lava, poison, ice, three capture zones, two traps and twenty numbered ball drop spots.
_legend: level = height step (0 = lowest). surface picks the look from the palette. sink = the surface sits this many world units lower than its level (a look only: the pools count as ground level). marker = something on the tile (painted, or a 3D piece with piece: true). zone: capture zone tiles (each 2x2 gets a frame that takes the colour of the player with more Pokemon in it). trap: a trap piece (right-click > Spring trap removes it). spawn2-star: player 2's controlled spawn.
_spots: Pokimari ball drop spots [row, col, number] (d20), painted like field markings, facing the board's sides.
_marker_style: plain: the spawns are painted as a translucent white S with the player's number as a subscript (Avia's, the user's choice for every map), facing their own player.
_board: The published board files the map picker uses (from tools/build_board.py; update when a new version is published), then run tools/build_arena_index.py.
_table: Image for the table around the board (placeholder until the arena gets its own).
_textures: Placeholders from tools/draw_placeholders.py: a dark mulch bed of bark chips with small clover patches (the user's pick, after a striped pitch looked like a golf course and dark slate came before it), ice, water, chips-over-soil edges; lava from Ingis, poison from Viperia.
